_comment: Single source of truth for the local servers the AI menu detects: servers the user installed and runs, which answer the OpenAI Chat Completions dialect (GET <base_url>/models, POST <base_url>/chat/completions). The driver never installs or starts them: it lists one only when its models endpoint answers, and sends it the requests of the openai format of api_providers.json, with no key unless the user gives one. A server's id must not be a provider id of api_providers.json. base_url is each project's documented default; _source names where it was read. llama-server (llama.cpp) and LocalAI both listen on port 8080 by default, so one probe covers both and the row names both.

omlx.label: oMLX
omlx._source: github.com/jundot/omlx: README ('Any OpenAI-compatible client can connect to http://localhost:8000/v1'), omlx/settings.py (host 127.0.0.1, port 8000), omlx/server.py (GET /v1/models, POST /v1/chat/completions; a key only when one is configured).

lmstudio.label: LM Studio
lmstudio._source: github.com/lmstudio-ai/docs 1_developer/3_openai-compat/index.mdx (base_url http://localhost:1234/v1; GET /v1/models, POST /v1/chat/completions with text and images).

llamacpp.label: llama.cpp / LocalAI
llamacpp._source: github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp tools/server/README.md (--host default 127.0.0.1, --port default 8080; GET /v1/models, POST /v1/chat/completions; images with --mmproj). github.com/mudler/LocalAI core/cli/run.go (LOCALAI_ADDRESS default :8080).

jan.label: Jan
jan._source: github.com/janhq/jan docs/src/pages/docs/desktop/api-server.mdx (host 127.0.0.1, port 1337, prefix /v1; a key only when one is set).
